standard-dialogue.npc: Looking for a bit of meat?
Meat! We've got all the good stuff here.

options.text: Why do you have all this meat?

steps.player: Why do you have all this meat?

steps.npc: Some prefer solids to go with their blood. That, and the werewolf visitors need something to eat too.

steps.player: Where does it all come from?

steps.npc: Look around you! There's no shortage of meat in these parts.

steps.player: You know what, I think I've heard enough.

steps.npc: Whatever you say. So, want some meat?
Come back if you ever want some meat!
